description:
STAGE 2 of the enforcement layer (Stage 1 shipped PR #26, 0ad68db). The JUDGMENT tier (Stage 1 was the deterministic tier). RATIFIED 2-stage split by polybius-the-stoa.

SCOPE:
- CAPTAIN_NOMOS — new 12th CAPTAIN (ground-truth auditor; returns CONFORMANT/DIVERGENT/UNVERIFIABLE; tools Bash/Read/Grep/Glob — no Agent (can't nest), no Write/Edit (audit-only), no Web). RATIFIED as new CAPTAIN (not a CATO/ARGUS mode) per one-job-per-agent. STAGE-2 DAEDALUS MUST first rule out the LIEUTENANT/skill alternative (agent-judgment vs mechanical-skill) before committing the seat. Brand-doc ripple (case study / app roster team-size) is OUT OF SCOPE — track separately.
- PostToolUse-on-Agent checker trigger (fires in parent context on sub-agent return; injects 'run the checker').
- bw-ground-truth detection: detect 'output diverges from bw ground truth'.
- re-decompose remediation + 3 guardrails (size-derail->split vs wrong-spec/blocked->escalate; attempt-cap N=2; granularity floor). Slots into MAJOR_PLINY §5.6 INCOMPLETE/UNVERIFIABLE protocol.

OUTSTANDING §7.7 DECISION (the load-bearing Stage-2 adjudication): the seat-tag canary collides with op-disc §7.7's mechanical-enforcement hard-lock (Arc-36 A2.5/A14: 'mechanical enforcement is a future arc IF non-compliance recurs'). RESOLUTION OPTIONS: (a) DROP the seat-tag canary — NOMOS uses DIRECT bw-state comparison (PLINY's lean; NO PRINCIPAL-gate needed); (b) UNLOCK §7.7 — treat this epic as the 'non-compliance recurs' trigger + revise §7.7 to keep the seat-tag canary (PRINCIPAL-gated). Adjudicate at Stage-2 design.

DESIGN BASIS: agents/design/arc-46/design-rev1.md Stage-2 components (on main). ARGUS Stage-2 items: R2 (consider SessionStart(matcher:compact) reprime — PostCompact is side-effect-only/can't-inject), R4 (re-decompose cap N=2 + bw-tracked count robustness vs orchestrator compaction), r1 (if keeping seat-tag, scope it to POLYBIUS-only). Web-verified hook surface (2026-05-23): PreToolUse deny / PostToolUse additionalContext / Agent-matcher / SubagentStop-can't-inject CONFIRMED; SubagentStart CAN inject (alternative).
